name: skill-review
title_zh: 给 Claude Code 技能做体检的审稿人
tagline_zh: 装之前先让它过一遍：结构、描述、工作流、token 效率、反模式，五维打分。别等装完才发现技能是个半成品。
tagline_en: Run it before you install: structure, description, workflow, token efficiency, anti-patterns — five-dimension.
desc_en: Quality review and audit for Claude Code skills. Analyzes skill structure, description quality, workflow design, token efficiency, and anti-patterns against best practices. Use when user wants to review a skill, audit a skill, check skill quality, evaluate a skill, critique a skill, lint a skill, or validate a skill. Triggers: 'review skill', 'audit skill', 'skill quality', 'check my skill', 'eval
why_zh: 它不夸你写得多好，只按最佳实践逐条对照，把「看似能用」背后的坑翻出来。有标准，不靠感觉。
why_en: No flattery — it checks against concrete best practices and surfaces hidden pitfalls. Standards over vibes.
limit_zh: 只审 Claude Code 技能（SKILL.md 结构），不审 MCP 服务器、插件或普通提示词。只给诊断报告。
limit_en: Audits only Claude Code skills (SKILL.md structure), not MCP servers, plugins, or plain prompts. Delivers a report, no auto-fixes.
title_en: Skill auditor that flags anti-patterns in Claude Code skills
